i am gettin confused in group users and all users. please explain the difference.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
There are three set of users

  • User
  • Group
  • Others

Let’s say you are the user (owner) and you have a development team under you who has access to your server and then there are other users on the system who are not part of the group, they can only read any file on the server.

So:

  • User → You (the owner)
  • Group → Your development team (e.g., devteam)
  • Others → Everyone else on the system

All users here mean user + group + others so, basically everyone who has any kind of access.
